query:
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CASE
                     WHEN entry_type = 'PX' AND credit_account = '511' THEN amount
                     WHEN entry_type = 'PX' AND debit_account = '511' THEN -amount
                     ELSE 0.0 END), 0.0) as "net!: f64"
                 FROM journal_entry WHERE voucher_no IN (?, ?)
